page.overview:
What is Air Temple Island?

The island was initially uninhabited and dominated by wilderness. Aang and Katara visited it in 102 AG with Appa, seeking a place to quietly discuss the development of the nearby-located, overcrowded Cranefish Town.

Around 110 AG, Team Avatar and the Air Acolytes began the construction of the air temple on the island, which Aang and Katara also turned into their home following their marriage.

As a teenager, Tenzin saw petty vandals defacing the airbending gates on the island, and followed them to the city, where all three were arrested after fighting.

Aang took the opportunity to bring them all back to the island, and teach them the Air Nomad way of conflict resolution, before they all worked to clean the gates. In 170 AG, when Korra was in need of an airbending master, she moved to Air Temple Island to be taught the ancient art by Tenzin. For the Avatar's airbending training, Tenzin used the temple's airbending gates to teach her how to move like a true airbender and be able to switch direction at a moment's notice. This proved to be a real challenge for Korra, and she ended up destroying the two-thousand-year-old gates with firebending in frustration, though they were later repaired by the Air Acolytes. Tarrlok, who was attempting to persuade Korra to join his task force, made a visit to the island, rudely interrupting the dinner of Tenzin's family and Korra. He left the island after being turned down by the Avatar herself but continued to try and change her mind by sending the council page to deliver extravagant gifts to the island.
